title: Soros Fund triples Intel stake, boosts Micron holdings in Q3 2026
digest:
Soros Fund Management increased holdings of Micron and Intel in Q3 2026, with Intel's stake growing over 27x to 2.83 million shares (valued $34M), becoming the fund's largest holding.

Micron's shares were raised by 58.9% to 35,618 shares (valued $3.8M). The total holdings of both companies now account for 4% of the fund's portfolio, per the 2026-09-30季报, disclosed on 2026-11-13 by Crypto Briefing.

representative.summary: 索罗斯基金第三季度增持美光和英特尔股票，英特尔持仓增长超27倍成最大持仓，显示其对芯片行业的持续看好。持仓详情：美光增持58.9%至35618股（估值3800万美元），英特尔增持27倍至283万股（估值3400万美元），占基金总持仓4%。披露文件为2026年9月30日季报，公开时间为2026年11月13日。
